changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 1.0.88[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]SIMKL: new sign-in[/COLOR]
-SIMKL has a new sign-in system and will retire the old one around April 2027. New sign-ins now use it: an eight-character code, plus a QR that already carries the code.
-Already signed in? Nothing changes. A Reconnect SIMKL button in Tracking Accounts moves you over with one code, keeping your history.
-The new sign-in renews itself in the background, so you are not asked again unless the device goes unused for six months or you remove it from SIMKL's Connected Apps.
-Deauthorizing now also withdraws access on SIMKL's side, and you are told at once if SIMKL grants read-only access.
[COLOR fffdb515]SIMKL: fixes[/COLOR]
-SIMKL now limits daily requests per user. The playback keep-alive runs every five minutes instead of ninety seconds, and when the daily allowance runs out the add-on waits for the reset instead of stalling playback.
-Trending Today, This Week and This Month load from SIMKL's public lists: no account needed and no allowance used.
-Stopping something SIMKL already marked as watched is no longer reported as a failure.
-Exported logs hide the new SIMKL tokens.
